_uwaga: Progi LVP (Low Visibility Procedures) z AIP (AIRAC AMDT 10-26, 01.10.2026): AD 2.22 lotnisk IFR, AIP MIL AD 4.20. Fazy: prep = przygotowanie (gdy AIP je podaje), lvp = wprowadzenie, cancel = odwołanie. Warunek [op, wartość]: op jak w AIP (<, <=, >, >=). rvr_m = RVR z METAR (najniższy z pasów), bez grupy RVR widzialność; ceiling_ft = podstawa chmur BKN/OVC/VV ('chmury pokrywające więcej niż połowę nieba'); vis_m = widzialność z METAR (lotniska wojskowe), rvr_eq_m = odpowiednik RVR z AIP, używany tylko, gdy METAR nie podaje widzialności. logic: or = wystarczy jeden warunek, and = wszystkie (AIP pisze przy odwołaniu czasem 'i/lub', liczymy wtedy 'i', jak wprost w AD 2.22 EPKT, EPRZ i EPLB). Histereza: LVP trwa, dopóki nie są spełnione warunki odwołania; po odwołaniu stan 'LVP ODWOŁANE' przez 30 min. Tendencji (poprawa / pogorszenie) z METAR nie oceniamy. scope DEP = LVP tylko dla odlotów (lotniska wojskowe). applies false = AIP nie przewiduje LVP (reason). verified false = progi niesprawdzone z AIP. DEFAULT dotyczy lotnisk bez wpisu (lotniska VFR i nieopublikowane w AIP).

DEFAULT.reason: No LVP in AIP (VFR aerodrome or no AIP data)

EPWA.note: cancellation 'and/or' taken as 'and', with a trend to further improvement; ILS CAT IIIA RWY 33, CAT II RWY 11, take-offs from RWY 29 or 15; no take-offs with RVR < 125 m

EPPO.note: AIP links preparation to a decreasing RVR trend, TAF forecast or aerodrome warning (not evaluated, thresholds only); cancellation with a sustained improving trend; ILS CAT II RWY 28 only, take-offs from RWY 10 or 28; no take-offs with RVR < 125 m

EPMO.note: para 5.1.2.2 gives ceiling '200 ft or less', the next sentence 'below 200 ft' (taken as < 200 ft); cancellation 'and/or' taken as 'and', with further improvement expected

EPLL.note: no preparation phase in AIP; cancellation at the earliest with all RVR ≥ 550 m and an improving trend

EPSY.note: new AMDT 10-26 text reconstructed from a page mixed with the old text (formerly: preparation 800 m / 300 ft, cancellation 600 m and 200 ft); no preparation phase in AIP

EPRZ.note: after LVP cancellation the aerodrome returns to the preparation phase

EPWR.note: for cancellation AIP says 'and/or and' (taken as 'and') and RVR 'more than 600 m'

EPGD.note: no preparation thresholds in AIP; cancellation 'and/or' taken as 'and', with further improvement expected

EPRA.reason: No LVP in AIP (AD 2.20 and AD 2.22 without LVP)

EPKS.note: departures only; preparation with a decreasing trend, cancellation with an increasing trend (METAR trend not evaluated)

EPMB.note: departures only; preparation with a decreasing trend, cancellation with an increasing trend (METAR trend not evaluated)

EPMI.note: departures only (TWR may skip LVP with no departures); preparation with a decreasing trend, cancellation with an increasing trend (METAR trend not evaluated)

EPPW.note: departures only; preparation with a decreasing trend, cancellation with an increasing trend (METAR trend not evaluated)

EPSN.note: departures only (TWR may skip LVP with no departures); preparation with a decreasing trend, cancellation with an increasing trend (METAR trend not evaluated)

EPOK.reason: No LVP in AIP MIL (only IFR helicopter take-off minima from a taxiway)
